title: On Curing the fever in three days
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：cure　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cure 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the musician ① cured the fever in three days without complaint, and every listener in the hall said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the musician ② cures the fever in three days with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ cure the fever in three days at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ cured the fever in three days before — a line in the programme for December 1975 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Curing the fever in three days without complaint, the musician said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ cure him of the habit at last with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Cure him of the habit at last at once and never mention it again.

By 1988 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new listener from the next hall ⑧ cures him of the habit at last without complaint every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the piano, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ cured the fever in three days again when nobody else would.

⑩ To cure the fever in three days, my mother said in 1993, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the hall remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the hall forgets, somebody cures the fever in three days with great care again and somebody must cure the fever in three days without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 治愈（一般过去式 cured the fever in three days：1981 年乐师头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 治愈（一般现在 cures the fever in three days：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 治愈（不定式 to cure the fever in three days：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 治愈（过去完成时 had cured the fever in three days：1975 年十二月的节目单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 治愈（动名词 curing the fever in three days 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 纠正（cure him of the habit at last：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去纠正终于改掉他那个习惯）
G. v. 纠正（cure him of the habit at last：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 治愈（后段两处：新来的听客照例 cures him of the habit at last，而母亲又一次 cured the fever in three days）

cure 意为“治愈”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯治愈三天里治愈那场热病”，此处为不定式 to cure the fever in three days。
cure 意为“治愈”，节目单里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1988 年之前就有人治愈过，故用过去完成时 had cured。

cure 意为“纠正”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去纠正终于改掉他那个习惯”，should ever 之后用原形 cure him of the habit at last。

cure 意为“治愈”，新来的听客每个夜晚都照例纠正终于改掉他那个习惯，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 cures。
cure 意为“治愈”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地治愈三天里治愈那场热病，用一般过去式 cured 叙述。
cure 意为“治愈”，结尾那句是母亲 1993 年的话：要治愈三天里治愈那场热病，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和音乐厅记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 cure 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1981 the musician cured the fever in three days without complaint, and nobody in the hall forgot it.
Even now the musician cures the fever in three days with great care whenever the hall asks.
Curing the fever in three days without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever cure him of the habit at last with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new listener from the next hall cures him of the habit at last without complaint every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother cured the fever in three days again, and the hall remembered that half.
